sentences.en: August, 2004 Keegan had his 3 month checkup with his Cardiologist today.

sentences.en: Tim Keegan is sat on a chair alongside the drummer who only has congas and shakers tonight.

sentences.en: And nobody has dared to seriously challenge it. · William Keegan is the Observer's senior economics correspondent.

sentences.en: Keegan's corner was met at the far post by a Cusack header which beat goalkeeper Alan O'Shea.

sentences.en: Keegan's signings aren't the international stars to guide us into the promised land.

sentences.en: Next month Kevin Keegan demonstrates winning ways with a bubble perm.

sentences.en: Thanks to Patrick Keegan for coming in to review the papers - regular listeners know that Patrick operates in the murky underworld of pr.
